verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions are its automation layer: they run on events, schedules, webhooks and cron (appwrite-docs-9, appwrite-docs-64). They deploy automatically from source control (appwrite-docs-74), and the CLI deploys functions from project config files (appwrite-docs-12, appwrite-docs-13), which gives git-based versioning. The branch-preview review flow is documented only for Sites, a frontend hosting product, so it does not carry over to automations, and nothing in the pack shows function rollback. Missing for 10: a documented review step for function changes, rollback to a previous function deployment, deployment-history docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
